hooks.command:
# The /events endpoint has no authentication. The loopback bind is its only guard.
# $PPID is the claude process. glancepad finds the terminal window from it.
curl -sf --max-time 2 -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" -H "x-glancepad-pid: $PPID" --data-binary @- http://127.0.0.1:4180/events >/dev/null || true
